text: Why choose to study this program? This prograq is offered by School of Electronic and Information Engineering (SEIE) of Beihang University, one of the earliest department of aeronautic electronic enigeering founded in China with a history of 50 years. Electronic information is a broad-range field. Great attention has been paid to cultivate personnel with technology in comprehensive IT manufacture, public network and private network, focused on electronic information technology applications. Main Courses Introduction of Electronic Information Engineering, Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, Introduction to Aeronautics and Astronautics, Software Technical Fundament, Circuit Analysic, Electromagnetic Field Theory, Signals and Systems, Analog Electronic Circuit, Digital Signal Processing, Electronic Measure etc. Internship and Career Development Students of this program could have many practices, like Engineering Cognition Practice, Metalworking Practice and Electronics Practice. The major is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge in electronic technology and information system, basic theory and techniques of information collection, processing and transmission, and basic practice in electronics and information engineering. It turns out senior engineering and technical personnel who are capable of information processing systems, communications systems and electronic equipment research, design, application development and operation analysis. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Engineering.
